facts.text: Canada's first lunar rover was set to explore a region of the Moon's south pole to gather scientific data to help find water ice. The project has since ended.
facts.source_title: First Canadian rover to explore the Moon (Canadian Space Agency)
facts.evidence: "explore a region of the lunar south pole and gather scientific data to help find water ice"; status: "Project ended"

facts.text: Canadarm3, Canada's planned contribution to the Lunar Gateway, consists of a large 8.5-metre arm and a smaller, more dexterous arm. It is in development, with delivery no earlier than 2029, and the date may change.
facts.evidence: "Canadarm3 will be Canada's contribution to Gateway"; "a large, 8.5-metre-long arm"; "a smaller, more dexterous arm"; status: In development, "No earlier than 2029"

facts.text: Canadian Space Agency astronaut Jeremy Hansen flew on Artemis II and became the first Canadian to go on a mission around the Moon.
facts.evidence: "Canadian Space Agency (CSA) astronaut Jeremy Hansen made history as the first Canadian to go on a mission around the Moon."
